reload_sentence_embedder: reload a pretrained sentence embedder model from a checkpoint path with given parameters
get_sentence_embeddings: get single-vector sentence embeddings from input token tensors and their lengths
get_layer_parameters: get trainable parameters for a specified transformer layer range including embeddings
switch_embedder_eval_mode: switch the sentence embedder model to evaluation mode for inference
move_embedder_to_cuda: move the sentence embedder model to GPU for accelerated computation
